GameApiSecurity.//: Sign-in throttling for the GnollHack game APIs and the website's account pages. The pair limit is per account and address; the account limit is across addresses. Per-IP limits need real client addresses: see docs/overseer/security-monitoring.md.

IdentityLockout.//: Shared by the website (MobileGnollHackLogger) and Overseer, which sign in against the same accounts: keep both files identical.

AccountHold.//: Holds an account deletion for administrator review. Shared by the website and Overseer: keep both files identical.
AccountHold.//SeriousProviderCodes: ProviderSafetyBlock / ProviderPolicyRejection event codes that name prohibited content. Refusals, usage volume and limit refusals never count.
AccountHold.//ReviewNotificationEmail: Address emailed when a deletion is held for review; empty = admin alert only.
AccountHold.//ReviewEmailMinIntervalHours: At most one review email per user account within this many hours.
AccountHold.//OverseerAdminUrl: Website only: the Overseer admin page the review email links to; empty = no link.
